profile: # Original signed Alpine APK overlay catalog. One row owns each profile's
# package, ELF and guest fixture identities. A tests/ path copies to itself;
# scripts/*-rootfs-copies.tsv holds explicit multiple or renamed copies.
# repositories = main | main+community (all APKs still signature-verified).
# m120-batch: Host-owned driver only; PPM/PGM/raw pixels are generated on the Linux host.
# m122-batch: The binary image fixtures are generated directly inside staged rootfs on host.
# m123-batch: ext2/FAT image fixtures are built on Linux host before rootfs.cpio.
# m124-batch: Host-generated binary fixtures are written by the M124 host configure hook.
# m125-batch: All image fixtures are prepared by the M125 host-configure hook.
# m126-batch: The M126 host-configure hook prepares all roff input fixtures outside NaSeed.
# m127-batch: Host hook generates audio fixtures before CPIO is archived.
